text:
maya: heads-up: planning an RBAC lockdown tonight for private deployments (22:00 UTC). goal: remove broad svc role bindings and restrict keystore/KMS decrypt to service-level roles. anyone on-call? :eyes:

dan: I can be on-call. quick Q: will audit logs for KMS decrypts go to the central SIEM or stay in the private cluster? need to know for retention/pipeline.

olivia: central SIEM via the forwarder is preferred, but for private we need an edge-forwarder config that egresses only to our collector endpoint. will need certs and allowlist.

lee: on netpol side — we're enabling connlimit + deny-egress-by-default for the model runners. make sure health-checks to load-balancers are allowed. also propose enabling conntrack metrics so we can triage port exhaustion during rollout.

maya: thanks. action items: (1) olivia set forwarder config & certs, (2) dan monitor SIEM ingest and retention, (3) lee prepare netpol patch + conntrack dashboards. I will run RBAC dry-run first.

sec-bot: preflight CI: rbac-dryrun job started (build 8842).

sec-bot: rbac-dryrun completed — 3 warnings, 1 failure. warnings: unused clusterroles on namespace `priv-models`. failure: serviceAccount `model-proxy` currently bound to `infra-admin`.

dan: model-proxy -> needs a scoped role: `model-proxy-readwrite-keystore` with only `decrypt` + `get` on secrets. will open PR.

olivia: for KMS, note difference: customer-managed keys (CMK) are rotated externally. we should not allow our platform key impersonation. add KMS-grant audit: log kms:Decrypt with principal.

lee: sample netpol snippet I tested locally:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```
This blocks egress — healthchecks need explicit rules. will include them.

maya: dan, when you open the PR please include an audit rule to capture `Decrypt` events, and a short grep test we can run post-deploy.

dan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rbac/merge_requests/512 — includes role + audit rule. test script attached in PR.

sec-bot: deploy-bot: canary apply scheduled at 22:00 UTC. will run in three clusters: priv-eu1, priv-na2, priv-ap1.

olivia: forwarding note — for priv clusters we'll use edge-forwarder v2 with pinning to collector hostname `collector.redwood-sec.local`. cert on `secrets/edge-forwarder-cert`. I'll push helm values after PR approves.

maya: risk: if connlimit blocks legitimate bulk telemetry we'll see false positive incident. plan to monitor conntrack metrics and have rollback flag ready.

lee: I'll add Grafana alert: conntrack_established > 80% for 2m AND egress_drops > 5m => paging.

dan: after deploy I'll run the grep test against SIEM: `grep 'kms:Decrypt' /var/log/siem/*.log | tail -n 50` — should show `model-proxy` entries within 2m of decrypt call.

maya: final checklist before 22:00: 1) PR merged (dan) 2) forwarder helm values in (olivia) 3) netpol/health rules tested (lee) 4) rollback playbook pinned (maya).

dan: merged. :thumbsup:

olivia: helm values pushed to branch `edge-forwarder/priv-2026` and cert placed in secrets repo.

lee: netpol applied to canary namespace and healthchecks pass. conntrack dashboard staged.

sec-bot: canary deploy started on priv-eu1 (22:00:03 UTC).

sec-bot: canary status: RBAC: success, Netpol: success, Forwarder: partial (certificate thumbprint mismatch in priv-ap1).

maya: pause. olivia can you check thumbprint mismatch? if it's a cert chain issue we might fail-forwarding.

olivia: investigating — looks like edge-forwarder on ap cluster has an older CA bundle. redeploying with updated CA.

sec-bot: canary resume after push.

sec-bot: canary status: all checks green. no sign of kms:Decrypt missing logs.

lee: monitoring shows a transient bump in conntrack but under threshold. Grafana alert not fired.

maya: good. rolling to other clusters with 10m wait. if anything pops, abort and rollback.

dan: noted. I linked the incident runbook here: https://docs.internal/redwood/sec/runbooks/priv-deploy-lockdown. keep an eye on SIEM for `unauthorized` KMS errors.

olivia: postmortem note: need automated cert-sync for edge-forwarder CA to avoid thumbs mismatch next time. filing follow-up.

maya: thanks team. will run a 24h audit after full rollout to ensure no missed decrypt events and check for any failed healthcheck spikes. :zap:
